purpose: Durable per-finding disposition map for the Opus RC4 release review. The approved plan's prose says fourteen findings; its Required-dispositions table holds fifteen distinct rows, all of which are dispositioned here.

findings.notes: Live current-tree ratchet with justified RC4 ceilings (262 files / 88,600 lines); RC2 numbers retained as historical evidence only; EN/RU changelog entries added.
Green 68-stage exact-HEAD gate bundle committed; disposition schema and tool generalized to admit 2.6.6-rc4 and its holistic-primary role. Disposition instance deferred to the join as D-266-RC4-05.
Cycle gating corrected at four sites (README.md x3, docs/model-routing.md x1); drift assertion derives all five cycles from compile_finalization_routes under both availability states.
Distinct RC4 artifact with id, scope, rationale, residual risk, remediation; digest asserted distinct from rc1, rc2, and v2.6.4.

Provider event kinds read from harness.provider_events (7, recovering input-accepted and provider-started); all tests/harness imports removed from the production script; simulator verbs moved to simulator_scenario_actions and cross-checked by the test layer (D-266-RC4-04).
Witness renamed to summary-disposition-classification; new release-boundary-rejection witness covers missing digest, byte substitution, symlink escape, parent traversal, absolute pointer.
Three divergent copies replaced by one owner with an explicit None policy; five negative cases pin each field's contribution.
One exact-HEAD completion path; already_awaiting, the sort arm, both non-exact arms, _should_defer_ready_results and _requires_lane_barrier removed. Orphaned gate method retained as D-266-RC4-01.

Binding created at dispatch for every review-enabled task; drifted binding fails closed at launch; missing binding tolerated for pre-field records and current-checkout reviews. E1 narrowed; residual gap is D-266-RC4-02.
Positional line-walk replaced by block/item parsing; no indentation inference. All existing weakening regressions preserved (D-266-RC4-03).
Certificate regenerated and republished; binding is digest agreement recomputed against the current tree, not a commit label. Out-of-lineage child HEAD retained as labelled provenance.
No operator path, session UUID, or provider tool identifier published; transcript byte offsets dropped; every evidentiary digest retained.
Packed signature and mapping lines reflowed, blank lines restored; the already-recorded retry now completes telemetry, closing the durable-completion crash window.
Enrolled as RC4-E11 with the semantic-start boundary, the bounded observation budget, and four-step operator recovery for input-unconfirmed.
Hand-inlined predicate removed; relaxation calls zero_effect_terminal_attempt and the exact predicate is documented.
